newsitem.title: ITALY: Paribas, Credito launch credit for Edison.
newsitem.headline: Paribas, Credito launch credit for Edison.

text.p: Credito Italiano and Banque Paribas have launched a 300 billion lire revolving credit facility for Italian energy group Edison SpA.
A Credito statement said it and Paribas had underwritten the entire amount of the seven-year facility which will be placed with Italian banks or Italian subsidiaries of foreign banks.
Edison is the main private Italian electricity producer, 61.3 percent controlled by the Montedison group. -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
